mods.name: agent-diet
mods.description: Runs search-only subagents (Explore by default) on Haiku instead of your main model; a model Claude asks for still wins, and /agent-diet picks the types and the model.

mods.name: answer-pane
mods.description: Explain, plan and ELI5 pages drawn natively in a side pane: diagrams in place, plan decisions as buttons, Respond fills the prompt box. No model calls.

mods.name: budget-guard
mods.description: Holds a prompt back once your 5-hour or weekly usage is at or over a limit you set (90% by default); sending it again goes through. No tokens spent.

mods.name: cache-clock
mods.description: Shows how long the prompt cache stays warm, and when it expires, exactly how many tokens your next message will re-send uncached. No tokens spent.

mods.name: cmd-diet
mods.description: Adds quiet flags to noisy shell commands before they run (git status, pytest, cargo, npm install, mvn, curl, wget, docker pull), so Claude reads short output from the start; errors, failures and warnings stay in full.

mods.name: collision-guard
mods.description: Asks before Claude edits a file another chat on this machine changed in the last 30 minutes. Each chat keeps its own small ledger; no model calls, no network.

mods.name: compact-keeper
mods.description: After a compaction, adds one message with exact facts from before it: your latest prompt in full, up to 4 earlier ones, the files edited, the todo list and the last failed shell command. At most 4,000 characters. No model calls.

mods.name: context-xray
mods.description: A pane with the exact breakdown of what fills Claude's context: system prompt, tools, memory files, skills, messages, and which tools load on every request.

mods.name: gh-account
mods.description: Runs each git push, pull, fetch, clone and gh command as the logged-in GitHub account that owns or belongs to the repository's owner, so Claude stops switching gh accounts and retrying failed pushes.

mods.name: kit-updates
mods.description: Tells you when a newer version of an installed claude-pro-kit mod is out, and /kit-update installs it along with any new mods you never had. One small download per session, no tokens spent.

mods.name: loop-guard
mods.description: Holds back a shell command once when the exact same command already failed twice in a row, and tells Claude to change approach; retrying it still goes through.

mods.name: nudge
mods.description: /nudge <goal> applies behavioral design to a product or flow: diagnose why users don't act, design interventions that remove barriers, ranked hypotheses to test, and an ethics check on every answer. Its guide reaches Claude only when you run /nudge.

mods.name: output-diet
mods.description: Trims long shell output, Grep results and subagent reports before Claude reads them (head, tail and error lines kept); the untrimmed text is saved to a file Claude can open.

mods.name: peek
mods.description: Typing "status" while background shells or subagents run opens a pane with each task's exact elapsed time, the tail of its output and any percent it printed, instead of sending the prompt to Claude. /peek opens it too. No tokens spent.

mods.name: pro-hud
mods.description: Desktop heads-up display for the Pro plan: exact 5h/7d usage gauges, context gauge, turn receipts, usage in the spinner and compact tool cards. No estimates, no tokens spent.

mods.name: prompt-polish
mods.description: An Improve button above the prompt (and /polish) rewrites your draft with Opus at low effort (/polish model picks another) using the prompt-master rules (MIT, nidhinjs/prompt-master); Undo puts the original back. Each press is one model call; its exact tokens are shown.

mods.name: read-cap
mods.description: Stops Claude reading a file over 1,000 lines whole (with Read, cat or Get-Content) and gives it an outline tool (definitions with line numbers) so it reads only the range it needs. A retry still reads it whole.

mods.name: reread-guard
mods.description: Stops Claude re-reading a file it already read in this conversation, with Read or a plain cat, sed -n, head, tail or Get-Content, when the file has not changed since; a deliberate second attempt still goes through.

mods.name: session-receipt
mods.description: /receipt opens a pane with the exact tokens every turn of the session spent (uncached, cached, output, subagents) and the costliest turns. No tokens spent.

mods.name: skill-diet
mods.description: Lists skills you have not used lately in this project by name only, so their descriptions stop riding along on every request; the Skill tool and /name still load any of them. No model calls.

mods.name: tool-diet
mods.description: Moves tools you have not used lately behind ToolSearch, so their descriptions stop riding along on every request; core tools and anything you used in your last five sessions stay loaded.

mods.name: turn-budget
mods.description: When one turn uses more than +5 session points or 500,000 uncached input tokens, writes a handoff from exact session data and copies it for a new session; the old session is never cleared. No model calls.

mods.name: write-guard
mods.description: Steers Claude to Edit instead of rewriting an existing file in full with Write: the first rewrite in a conversation goes through with a one-line note, a later one is held back once; a deliberate retry still goes through.

ambareeshav/claude-pong-mod.name: claude-pong-mod
ambareeshav/claude-pong-mod.description: Pong for Claude Code: rally against an AI paddle above the prompt while Claude works, zero tokens. A function-hooks mod.

ambareeshav/prs.name: prs
ambareeshav/prs.description: PR review for Claude Code: browse and review GitHub or Azure DevOps pull requests in a docked side panel via /prs — file tree, diffs, commits. A function-hooks mod.

yash-gadodia/claude-mods.name: claude-mods
yash-gadodia/claude-mods.description: Claude Code mods that keep an agent honest — function hooks that guard scope, verify deploys, and draw the session above the prompt.

mods.name: chrome-switch
mods.description: Switches the Claude in Chrome extension between named browser profiles with select_browser, which needs no approval click, and picks the default before the first browser call of a session.

mods.name: copy-band
mods.description: Click-to-copy buttons above the prompt for every code block and quoted draft in the last answer, a durable stash of older ones, and a WhatsApp/Telegram wrap.

mods.name: deploy-verify
mods.description: After a deploy command succeeds, curls the live URL with cache-busting and puts the verdict in the model's context, so a deploy cannot be claimed without evidence.

mods.name: diff-review
mods.description: After every Edit, Write, NotebookEdit or sed -i, a docked pane shows that file's uncommitted hunk with [keep] and [revert] buttons; a press dismisses or runs git checkout with no model turn.

mods.name: done-blink
mods.description: Blinks the iTerm2 tab orange when a turn lands, for up to three minutes or until you type again, so a finished session is obvious from any other tab.

mods.name: merge-gate
mods.description: Denies a Bash merge (gh pr merge, git merge on main, push onto main) unless the latest human message says the word merge; ship, push and deploy do not count.

mods.name: mini-offload
mods.description: Routes heavy Bash commands (test suites, builds, Docker) to a second machine over ssh, with the PATH export and working directory already right, and the commit synced first.

mods.name: money-band
mods.description: A line above the prompt with liquid assets, CPF, debt and month-to-date spend, read from a pair of SQLite databases over ssh, and the emergency fund's fill in the prompt footer.

mods.name: receipt
mods.description: Keeps a per-turn tally of edits, runs, curls and destructive commands and shows it on the turn footer; a claim with no run flags the spinner, a destructive Bash unfolds its tool group, and an edit-without-run turn suggests running the tests.

mods.name: scope-guard
mods.description: Counts the distinct files a turn edits and stops at a threshold to make the goal get restated, so a small ask cannot quietly become a refactor.

mods.name: usage-band
mods.description: A line above the prompt with the five-hour and seven-day limit windows, this session's context fill and cost, plus a nudge to clear when the window gets expensive. The footer shows the cost in Singapore dollars.

mods.name: wod-band
mods.description: A pixel-art Ragtag athlete above the prompt who does a rep every turn: the session is an AMRAP of thrusters, burpees and pull-ups.

mods.name: wod-timer
mods.description: 3, 2, 1, GO above the prompt when you submit, a running gym clock while Claude works, and your split when the turn lands.

m4cd4r4/clear-resume.description: Write a handover when a Claude Code session gets long, type /clear, and the next session picks up where you left off with nothing to paste.

andrewbakercloudscale/claude-code-cost-s.name: usage-panel
andrewbakercloudscale/claude-code-cost-s.description: The usage panel in a sidebar inside Claude Code: this session, today, the last 30 days, projects, top sessions, the day's costliest turns with why each was dear, what pauses cost in cache written again, and insights, with graphs, and, where Claude Burst is installed, the context it really sends by part and Plan Utilisation: how much of the plan's 5-hour and weekly limits is used and which projects used it, with a warning as one gets close. /usage-panel opens it, /usage-panel pin and /usage-panel unpin choose whether every session opens it
